description: G-FORM cannot pass on the reviewed revisions: (1) F2a fails the canonical binding gate R17/R18/R19/R22 and its extension_predicate block is missing; (2) F2b content passes the canonical gate but has a false leakage-lint exemption and a node_id mismatch; (3) the aggregator schemas/af_scc_regularities.yaml pins C2 21df6f7f / C0 cb897b29 while disk has 23fec0e9 / e6b1af2b, so w05 A3/C6 fail on drift; (4) the data-class freeze (smooth-with-decay vs Sobolev H^4_{1/2+eps}) is still open, blocking transfer rule T1.
needed_to_unblock: lead-formulation freeze decision + F2a fix (define extension_predicate, replace statement_formal, fix metadata) + F2b fix (line-5 comment/exemption, node_id) + aggregator re-pin after freeze; then re-run both canonical gates and the w05/w06 lints and re-issue reviewer verdicts on the frozen hashes.
next_falsifier: If both canonical gates return PASS on frozen hashes, the aggregator pins match disk, and one data class is frozen across F1/F2a/F2b, this blocker is resolved.
